name: agents.sessions.setStatus
desc: Set an agent session's lifecycle status, creating the session if needed.

channel_id.desc: ID of the channel containing the agent session.

thread_ts.desc: Timestamp of the thread root message the session is scoped to. Required for thread-based sessions in regular channels and DMs. Must be omitted for session channels.

title.desc: Title for the agent session (max 200 characters). Only used when creating a new session; ignored if the session already exists. To rename an existing session, use agents.sessions.rename.

initiator_user_id.desc: The user who initiated the session. Only used when creating a new session; ignored if the session already exists. Must be a member of the channel.

icon_emoji.desc: Emoji to use as the agent's icon. Takes priority over icon_url. Remains in effect until you clear it (pass null) or set a new value. Requires the chat:write.customize scope.

icon_url.desc: URL to an image to use as the agent's icon. Remains in effect until you clear it (pass null) or set a new value. Requires the chat:write.customize scope.

username.desc: Display name override for the agent (max 200 characters). Remains in effect until you clear it (pass null) or set a new value. Requires the chat:write.customize scope.
